purpose: Test whether the 326 Q10-RMT rows without individually helpful prefixes through 16 ULP have pairwise or triplewise joint authority under exact sequential-f32 replay.

parent.receipt_resolution: Use exactly this canonical immutable receipt root; never mix archived, failed, shard, or probe directories.

replay_inputs.endpoint_reconstruction: fixture initial_weight_bits plus hash-bound DA2 selected_steps
replay_inputs.serialized_move_policy: moves.jsonl contains only moves with raw/helpful/worse rows; absence is metadata, not illegal

scope.target_definition: rows.json records with k_star == null/none and class_final == no_local_authority
scope.target_parent_invariant: every target has zero one_step_helpful_coordinates and no helpful prefix through 16 ULP

readout.arithmetic: exact learner-order sequential IEEE-754 binary32 replay
readout.comparison: bitwise output comparison with signed-zero identity
readout.ulp_order: the monotonic binary32 ULP ordering sealed by Q10-RMT
readout.helpful_definition: candidate row ULP distance is strictly smaller than the parent baseline ULP distance
readout.exact_target_definition: candidate row bits equal parent target bits

raw_support.neighborhood_definition: For each target endpoint-row, the union of coordinate IDs in all parent move records whose raw_rows contain that row.
raw_support.receipt_cross_check: The move-derived union must equal the row record all_raw_coordinates exactly.
raw_support.prefix_meaning: one final committed coordinate value relative to the immutable parent endpoint; no independently selectable increments
raw_support.prefix_domain_source: deterministic replay from hash-bound source fixture and DA2 selected_steps; serialized RMT moves are a cross-check
raw_support.missing_prefix_records: replay deterministically; fail closed only when fixture replay is unavailable or contradictory

replay.candidate_state: cloned f32 endpoint with one final prefix per selected coordinate
replay.application: selected coordinate values are applied simultaneously before a fresh sequential readout
replay.individuals: replay every legal nonzero prefix for every raw-support coordinate as an invariant check
replay.pairs: enumerate every legal prefix tuple for every unordered coordinate pair when the complete domain fits budget
replay.triples: after complete pair work finds no pair authority, enumerate every legal prefix tuple for every unordered coordinate triple when the complete domain fits budget
replay.stop_rule: A lower-order class may stop higher-order work only after that entire lower-order declared domain is complete; no partial success is used to claim domain completeness.
replay.candidate_mutation: in-memory clones only; no canonical state, parent receipt, or predecessor is mutated

classification.individual: At least one legal single-coordinate prefix improves the row. Expected count is zero; any occurrence fails closed as a parent invariant violation.
classification.pair: No individual prefix helps and a complete legal pair domain contains a helpful candidate.
classification.triple: No individual or pair prefix helps and a complete legal triple domain contains a helpful candidate.
classification.higher-order-or-untested: A pair/triple domain is budget-incomplete, a neighborhood has more than three coordinates after pair/triple work, or bounded higher-order escalation ends without a complete domain.
classification.no-effect-within-domain: The complete domain for a neighborhood of one, two, or three coordinates is exhaustively replayed with no helpful candidate. This is not global impossibility.

escalation.pair_incomplete_policy: deterministic lexicographic prefix/coordinate replay up to the pair budget; classify higher-order-or-untested if the full pair domain is not covered
escalation.triple_incomplete_policy: deterministic lexicographic replay up to the triple budget followed by bounded beam candidates; classify higher-order-or-untested if the full triple domain is not covered
escalation.higher_order_seed_order: stable coordinate tuple order, then stable prefix tuple order
escalation.intermediate_objective_pruning: no final geometry or monotonic mismatch gate
escalation.diversity_key: stable prefix signature plus exact cloned endpoint bytes

geometry_gates.intermediate_axis_norm_linear_debt: record but do not use as a final-gate pruning rule
geometry_gates.geometry_invalid_readout_authority: retain as raw diagnostic; set geometry_qualified false

fail_closed: any parent protocol, result, status, preexecution, or receipt-file hash mismatch
missing, extra, archived, failed, mixed, or ambiguous parent receipt root
parent status or Q10-RMT invariant mismatch
target count not exactly 326 or duplicate target endpoint-row identity
target row does not have k_star none, final no_local_authority, or zero one-step helpful coordinates
baseline or target sequential-f32 replay mismatch
individual helpful result in the parent target set
nonfinite arithmetic, invalid f32 state, bounds violation, or reserve violation
classifying budget exhaustion or incomplete coverage as no-effect-within-domain
treating a partial intermediate geometry state as a final geometry result
writing or mutating Q10-RMT or any other predecessor
canonical repair application, scientific bundle use, behavioral measurement, or DH08B field/process
source fixture or DA2 results hash mismatch
missing legal prefix cannot be deterministically replayed from the frozen endpoint fixture
duplicate or contradictory serialized prefix record
